identity_limits: seal1 is a local textual section label, not an independently identified physical seal.
P533185/S999999 is the generic dummy seal record per CDLI, not proof of shared seal ownership.
BDTNS remarks that CUSAS40/2 1582 and Nisaba15/2 0371 may be the same text but year-names differ; no physical identity adjudication from this handcopy.
Anonymous453801 is a catalogue label, not a verified museum accession or independently known owner.
Recipient names in the body do not establish the sealer or seal owner.
The statement Seal illegible is an editorial assessment; absent seal depiction is not proof that a future photograph cannot recover it.
next_evidence_needed: A photograph or original seal-impression drawing explicitly tied to this tablet, followed by script and ownership verification. The present handcopy does not provide that bridge.
